fields.label: CTL Threshold (Minutes)
fields.description: Alert if a token is stuck at any stage for more than this many minutes

fields.label: Escalation Email
fields.description: Email address to send stuck vehicle alerts to (IT Head / Plant Head)

fields.label: Token Suffix Digits
fields.description: Number of random digits in token suffix (4 = 1000-9999, 5 = 10000-99999)

fields.label: Default Warehouse
fields.description: Target warehouse for Purchase Receipt items (e.g. Raw Material Store)

fields.label: Default Accepted Warehouse
fields.description: Accepted warehouse for Purchase Receipt (if different from default)

fields.label: Auto-Submit GRN
fields.description: If checked, Purchase Receipt will be auto-submitted after creation

fields.label: Block GRN on Inspection Pending (Stores Dashboard)
fields.description: When ON (default), Stores Receiving Dashboard blocks GRN creation for Non-RM no-weighing tokens until Material Inspection is Approved. Turn OFF only to allow GRN bypassing inspection (not recommended).

fields.label: v2.8 Flow Enabled (Gross → Tare direct, no Unloading gate)
fields.description: v2.8.0 flow simplification: allows Tare Weight immediately after Gross (no Unloading Entry gate). Default ON. Turn OFF only for 48h kill-switch fallback to legacy flow. Writable by IT Head / System Manager only (permlevel 1).

fields.label: v2.8.1 QC Gate at PI (blocks Purchase Invoice until QI Approved)
fields.description: v2.8.1 Phase B: when ON, Purchase Invoice save is blocked unless every linked Token has an Approved Quality Inspection. Default OFF at deploy — flip ON only after QI team is ready to sign invoices. CEO/SM/IT Head can override per-PI via ts_qc_override. Writable by IT Head / System Manager only (permlevel 1).

fields.label: Enforce RST Number on Weighbridge
fields.description: v2.8.2: When enabled, makes RST Number mandatory on Weighbridge Gross entry + enforces numeric/uniqueness checks. Kill-switch for rollback. Writable by IT Head / System Manager only (permlevel 1).

fields.label: Enable Two-Pass Gate Flow (G2 Entry/Exit for Material)
fields.description: v2.8.3: when ON, Material flow requires G2 Entry before WB Gross + G2 Exit before G1 Exit. Token.status uses new values 'G1 Entered', 'G2 Entered', 'Plant Exited', 'Campus Exited'. Writable by IT Head / System Manager only (permlevel 1).

fields.label: Enable PO Approval
fields.description: Master switch — if unchecked, Purchase Orders submit directly without approval chain

fields.label: Enable MR Approval
fields.description: Master switch for Material Request approval workflow

fields.label: Default Purchase Category
fields.description: Fallback category if PO items don't match any configured Item Group mapping

fields.label: Enable Budget Check on PO
fields.description: If checked, PO submission for approval will check budget availability. CEO can override.

fields.label: Default Monthly Distribution
fields.description: Default monthly distribution template for new budget proposals

fields.label: Approval CTL (Hours)
fields.description: Alert if a PO is stuck at any approval level longer than this

fields.label: Approval CTL Alert Email
fields.description: Email for stuck-approval alerts (typically IT Head)

fields.label: Auto-Escalate Stuck POs
fields.description: Auto-forward POs to next approval level after CTL breach

fields.label: Notification Manager
fields.description: IT Head or admin who can manage the notification recipient list

fields.label: Post-Approval Notification Recipients
fields.description: Users to notify after PO/MR final approval or rejection

fields.label: Enable Material Inspection
fields.description: Auto-create inspection when Non-RM items arrive at G2. Requester/HOD must approve before GRN.

fields.label: 2nd Notification (Hours)
fields.description: Reminder notification after these many hours

fields.label: 3rd Notification (Hours)
fields.description: Warning notification after these many hours

fields.label: 4th Final Notification (Hours)
fields.description: Final notice to Requester + HOD + IT Head. Status changes to Auto-Proceeded.

fields.label: Notify IT Head on 4th
fields.description: Include IT Head in the 4th (final) notification

fields.label: G2 Print Controls (IT Head Only)
fields.description: Control what G2 Gate Operator can print. Only IT Head can change these settings.

fields.label: G2 Print Mode
fields.description: Slip Only: G2 can print compact slip. Detailed + Slip: G2 can print both formats. Applies to Token and Gate Entry.

fields.label: MD Dashboard PIN Lock (System Manager Only)
fields.description: Set a secret PIN to protect the MD Dashboard and Wall Display. Leave blank to disable PIN lock. Only System Manager can change this.

fields.label: MD Dashboard PIN
fields.description: 4-6 digit PIN required to access MD Dashboard and MD Wall Display. Only System Manager can set this.

fields.label: Weighbridge URL
fields.description: URL of the weighbridge weight reading endpoint (e.g., http://122.186.18.59:5001/read)

fields.label: Timeout (seconds)
fields.description: Maximum time to wait for weighbridge response

fields.label: Require CEO Approval
fields.description:
ON: IT Head creates request → CEO must approve before operators can backdate.
OFF: IT Head creates request → activates immediately, no CEO needed.

fields.label: Always-On Backdating (Quick Enable)
fields.description: Turn this ON to let ALL operators backdate entries right now — no request needed. Just set the date range.

fields.label: Enable Backdating for All Operators
fields.description: When ON: All G1, G2, Weighbridge, QI, Stores operators can set past dates on their forms immediately.

fields.label: Allow Backdating FROM This Date
fields.description: Operators can set dates starting from this date. Example: If set to April 1, operators can backdate to April 1 or later.

fields.label: Allow Backdating UNTIL This Date
fields.description: IMPORTANT: Set this to today or a future date! If this date is in the past, backdating will NOT work. Example: Set to April 30 to allow backdating until end of April.

fields.label: Maximum Days in Past
fields.description: How far back can operators go? Default: 30 days. Set to 0 for no limit.

fields.label: Expiry Warning (Minutes)
fields.description: IT Head gets a warning notification this many minutes before a request expires. Default: 30 minutes.
